description: Isoalloxazine (flavin) ring system produces three characteristic UV-Vis bands: 266 nm (S₀→S₂, ε ~27700), 373 nm (S₀→S₁ shoulder, ε ~10600), and 445 nm (S₀→S₁, ε ~12500) — the visible bands giving riboflavin its characteristic yellow colour.
transition: π → π* (S₀→S₂ at 266 nm; S₀→S₁ at 445 nm) and n → π* vibronic bands
clinicalNote: Water-soluble B-complex coenzyme (FMN/FAD precursor). Pharmacopoeial assay at 444 nm in water. Photosensitive — store in amber vessels.

sources.citation: Koziol J (1966) 'Fluorimetric analyses of riboflavin and its coenzymes', Methods Enzymol 18B:253-285. ε 266 nm = 27700, ε 373 nm = 10600, ε 445 nm = 12500 in water.
sources.purpose: Molar absorptivity at all three characteristic bands

sources.citation: British Pharmacopoeia 2023, Riboflavin Monograph. UV assay at 444 nm in water.
